column1: # Solar System Explorer — video source manifest.
# Source download is cached by YouTube id, so re-cutting after tweaking a window
# is seconds. IDs must match SolarData.gd (file written: game/videos/<id>.ogv).
# Windows come from the creator's own chapter markers on this single tour video:
# Kid-clean narrated animation; used for the private family device, same posture
# as ant_explorer's clips. Credit the channel; swap for public-domain NASA
# footage if this ever ships beyond the gift.
# Asteroid belt is a short on-point beat in the source (~14s); best clean footage.
# Pluto lives in the Kuiper Belt / dwarf-planet beat.
